caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden chair rendered in fine black ink lines on an off-white background. The chair has a high, rectangular back with a rounded, scalloped top edge and two finials at the upper corners. The seat is flat, and the armrests are wide with gently curved contours and scroll-shaped ends. Four turned legs support the chair, connected by a set of horizontal stretchers, with an additional wavy stretcher in front, beneath the seat. The wood grain is indicated with lines and shading. There are no additional objects or background elements present, and the artist's signature, "Edward T. Jewett," appears in small lettering in the lower right corner of the composition.
title: Chair (Scale Drawing)
